note:
"Awesome cold showers" - an awesome list that tempers hype with reality. Some choice examples:

> [on verification techniques] Extensive literature review showing that formal methods are hard to learn, extremely expensive to apply, and often miss critical bugs.

> [on static vs. dynamic typing]  A review of all the available literature (up to 2014), showing that the solid research is inconclusive, while the conclusive research had methodological issues.

> Benchmarking cutting-edge graph-processing algorithms running on 128-core clusters against a single-threaded 2014 Macbook Pro. The laptop consistently wins, sometimes by an order of magnitude.
